page: Amazon Web Services i3en.large is a storage-optimized instance type featuring 2 vCPUs and 16.0 GB of DDR4 memory. Powered by an Intel Xeon 8259CL processor with an x86_64 architecture, it operates with 1 physical core and 2 threads per core at a clock speed of 3.1 GHz. The CPU includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports AVX-512 instructions. A key hardware feature is the inclusion of 1250 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, alongside a baseline network bandwidth of 2 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates that the compute and memory subsystems operate in lower performance tiers. The single-core stress-ng performance is recorded at 1318.68, while the multi-core score is 1731.97, placing both in the bottom 25% and 10% respectively. Memory bandwidth tests show a read-only large block speed of 13.72 GB/sec and a write speed of 11.8 GB/sec. Database operations, such as Redis SET operations, achieve 1.65 million operations per second, and static web serving throughput reaches 1.87 GB/sec.

The primary tradeoff of the i3en.large is its high storage-to-compute ratio. While it offers a substantial 1250 GB of local NVMe SSD storage, its processing capabilities are limited by the dual-vCPU configuration and lower benchmark percentiles. From a cost-efficiency perspective, this instance provides high local storage density per unit of compute, making it suitable for storage-heavy workloads that do not require intensive CPU processing. Appropriate workloads include local caching, small database hosting, and basic storage-intensive applications.
